claims.reason: The support-fibre identity is correct but gives no global inequality for the selected weighted slopes. claims.statement: For each support s with lambda_s original leaf neighbors, H_s=(1+z)^(lambda_s-1) product_u I(C_{s,u};z), R_s=product_u I(C_{s,u}-u;z), and Q_s=H_s-R_s. For any original leaf v at s, I(T-v;z)=H_s+zR_s; its strict favorable selector and target summand are the stated coefficient differences, and grouping by s weights the common selected term by lambda_s.
claims.scope: All finite ordinary trees and integer p, with zero-extended coefficients and distinct original leaf tags; no residual premise.
claims.reason: The disjoint-component decomposition after deleting s proves the H and R products; partitioning independent sets of T-v by containing s proves H+zR. Coefficient extraction and support grouping are exact. Parsed pinned replay data agree exactly, and separate closed-form checks reproduce both examples.
